Market Activity FAQs
Site & Market Data
How frequently is news updated on this site?
Nasdaq.com syndicates news feeds from various providers; all stories are automatically posted as soon as we receive them.
What primary sources do you use for your press releases?
We receive press releases from several feeds, including:
BusinessWire
PRNewswire
GlobeNewswire
Accesswire
NewMediaWire
Newsfile
JCN
Dividend History
Nasdaq.com’s
Dividend History
page provides straightforward historical dividends data for stocks. Dividend payout records can be used to gauge the company's long-term performance when analyzing individual stocks.
This feature is only available for Nasdaq listed stocks.
Historical information is not adjusted for stock splits.
Dividend Calendar
Visit our
Dividend Calendar.
Please note that the dividend history for Nasdaq stocks may also combine the regular dividends with special dividends. Our partner, Quotemedia, provides the upcoming ex-dividend dates for the next month.
Please note that the dividend history might include the company’s preferred securities as well.
P/E Ratio
Price/Earnings Ratio is a widely used stock evaluation measure. For a security, the Price/Earnings Ratio is given by dividing the Last Sale Price by the Actual EPS (Earnings Per Share).
Historical NOCP
Nasdaq Official Closing Price (NOCP), which is derived from the closing auction on Nasdaq, reflects actual sale prices at one of the most liquid times of the day.
Earnings Date
The earnings date is derived from an algorithm based on a company's historical reporting dates and is provided by
Zacks Investment Research
. In case of any issues with the earnings date, please contact Zacks directly.
Visit the
Earnings Calendar
to see the upcoming and previously reported earnings.
How much lag is involved when accessing stock prices?
Trading information on Nasdaq is provided using real-time data from Nasdaq Data Link.
The Nasdaq Indices are delayed at least 1 minute. Mutual Funds are updated at the end of each day.
Summary Quote Pages
Key Data: Sector & Industry
This information helps to understand where the revenue of the company is derived.
Source: Quotemedia provides the SIC Code which is then mapped to sector and industry.
Key Data: Market Cap
The Market Cap is a calculated using the Total Shares Outstanding (TSO) multiplied by the current last sale; gives context to the company.
Source: Quotemedia utilizes information in the 10K and 10Q SEC Filings.
Key Data: Dividend
The dividend section reflects historical data and doesn’t project future or upcoming announced dividends (as these are subject to change).  The annualized dividend (per share) is a calculated field that takes the last dividend and frequency of the dividend (common frequencies include quarterly or monthly).  Current Yield is a value calculated by annualized (per share) dividend current stock price. For Historical and upcoming dividend dates and details, visit the “Dividend History” page per stock.
Source: Nasdaq.
What are the market hours for different trading sessions?
Regular Market Hours: 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET
Pre-Market Trading: 4:00 AM - 9:30 AM ET
After-Hours Trading: 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM ET
When are the Market Holidays?
Download the
Stock Market Holiday Schedule
.
Lists & Rankings
How does Nasdaq define the "Ten Most Advanced" and "Ten Most Declined" on the "Most Active" page?
The Advanced/Declined information is based on the percentage increase/decrease in stock price of Nasdaq Global and Global Select Market securities (and includes warrants and units). The information on
Most Active
is updated every minute.
Charts & Technical Data
How often are the Intraday charts updated?
The intraday charting service pulls the last sale and volume data for stocks from our data source every minute.
What time frames are available for stock charts?
Charts are available in multiple time frames including:
Intraday (1-minute, 5-minute, 15-minute, hourly intervals)
Daily, Weekly, Monthly
1-year, 2-year, 5-year, and 10-year historical views
What technical indicators are available on the charts?
Common technical indicators include moving averages, volume, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and other standard technical analysis tools.
IPOs & New Listings
How can I find information about recent IPOs?
Visit our I
PO section
under Market Activity, which includes upcoming IPOs, recent listings, and historical IPO performance data.
Why is "Price" on the "This Week's Expected IPOs" table listed as a range?
This field indicates the anticipated initial public offering price range, as filed with the SEC. The actual IPO price may differ from this estimated range.
What is the source of the IPO information?
The data is powered by EDGAR® Online LLC, a subsidiary of OTC Markets Group. Expected IPO dates are estimated by EDGAR® Online, which are based on dates in the company’s filings. These expected dates are not official and are not endorsed by Nasdaq.
Indices & Market Statistics
How often are market indices updated?
Most
Nasdaq indices
are updated in real-time during market hours, with at least a 1-minute delay for public display.
What is the difference between Nasdaq Composite® and the Nasdaq-100®?
Nasdaq Composite: Includes all domestic and international common stocks listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market®
Nasdaq-100: Includes the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq by market capitalization
Trading Halts & Suspensions
What causes a trading halt?
Trading halts may occur due to:
Pending news announcements
Regulatory concerns
Volatility or unusual market activity
Technical issues
Failure to meet listing requirements
How can I find information about trading halts?
Current trading halts and suspensions are listed in the Market Activity section on the Summary page for the stock, in the Notifications area of the page. You can also find
lists of non-compliant companies
and
issues pending suspension or delisting
.
Note that Nasdaq is unable to provide details about regulatory matters concerning any individual security that may be halted. Additional details about a particular company’s halt status can be found on the
Nasdaq Trader website
.
